Forecast of a GARCH model for the next days

Source: R/fct_volatility.R
garch_forecast.Rd

The variance the model expects for each of the next days, and the range of the return from the last close to the end of each day. The variance of the next day is known from the last day, omega + alpha * e^2 + beta * variance, and later days fall back to the long-run variance omega / (1 - alpha - beta) at the rate alpha + beta a day. The range of the next day is exact, from the Student-t distribution of the model; the ranges of the later days come from paths simulated paths of the model, with a fixed seed so that they do not change from one run to the next.

Usage

garch_forecast(garch, e_last, variance_last, days, level, paths = 50000)

Arguments

garch

A model from garch_fit().

e_last

The last day's return minus mu, in percent.

variance_last

The variance the model expected for the last day.

days

Number of days to forecast.

level

Probability of the range, such as 0.95.

paths

Number of simulated paths.

Value

A data frame with a row per day and the columns day, sigma (the daily standard deviation the model expects, in percent) and the quantiles of the log return from the last close, in percent: low and high for the range of probability level, low_50 and high_50 for the middle half, and median.

Examples

garch <- list(mu = 0.05, omega = 0.4, alpha = 0.1, beta = 0.85, nu = 4)
golemstockindices:::garch_forecast(garch, e_last = -5, variance_last = 6, days = 7, level = 0.95)
#>   day    sigma        low    low_50     median  high_50      high
#> 1   1 2.828427  -5.502890 -1.431394 0.05000000 1.531394  5.602890
#> 2   2 2.828427  -7.774688 -2.097403 0.08561467 2.272838  7.924958
#> 3   3 2.828427  -9.519619 -2.609086 0.12640947 2.876574  9.759043
#> 4   4 2.828427 -10.899962 -3.002712 0.19307256 3.400057 11.381648
#> 5   5 2.828427 -12.130463 -3.350509 0.26002110 3.844832 12.667964
#> 6   6 2.828427 -13.212424 -3.681198 0.32123444 4.250505 13.923125
#> 7   7 2.828427 -14.333559 -3.958686 0.32850063 4.661422 14.862589
